title: A Study in Stillness
author: Harf-e-Raast
excerpt: The Sukoon collection was made during one month of deliberate silence. What emerges when the artist removes intention and lets the letter arrive on its own terms?
body: The Sukoon collection was made during one month of deliberate silence. What emerges when the artist removes intention and lets the letter arrive on its own terms?
